creative_improvements.idea: Fix PUMP_CHAIN_LONG_RSI_MAX=70 enforcement + lower LONG_RSI_CEILING 80→70 as hard block
creative_improvements.rationale: The data is unambiguous: LONG RSI 60-70 is a killing field (53T 37.7%WR -$1.79/14d). pump-chain+ has its own RSI_MAX=70 but it's never enforced — 15 trades entered at RSI 60-70 when they should have been blocked. Additionally, LONG_RSI_CEILING=80 returns AMBIGUOUS (soft penalty) instead of SKIP (hard block). Two fixes: (1) Add PUMP_CHAIN_LONG_RSI_MAX enforcement in signal_compactor.py. (2) Lower LONG_RSI_CEILING 80→70 and change to hard block. Combined expected: +$1.73-2.11/14d.
creative_improvements.risk: low — blocks losing band, preserves winning 50-60 band

creative_improvements.idea: SHORT RSI 40-50 hard block — same pattern as LONG RSI 60-70
creative_improvements.rationale: SHORT RSI 40-50 = 37T 40.5%WR -$2.20/14d (second worst band after <30 which is already blocked by SHORT_RSI_FLOOR=50). Adding SHORT_RSI_CEILING=45 (block SHORT when RSI < 45) would save ~$2.20/14d. But SHORT_RSI_FLOOR=50 already covers RSI <50. Wait — the FLOOR blocks RSI <50, so RSI 40-50 SHOULD be blocked. If trades are still entering at RSI 40-50, there's another enforcement gap.
